title: Fix <lichen/l2/ipv6_addr.h> include resolution module-wide
description: Found while verifying project-LICHEN-6mij.2.2. Five TUs #include <lichen/l2/ipv6_addr.h> but no CMake include dir maps the lichen/ prefix to subsys/lichen, so they all fail: fatal error: lichen/l2/ipv6_addr.h: No such file or directory. Affected: subsys/lichen/oscore/coap_oscore.c, subsys/lichen/coap/coap_server.c, subsys/lichen/coap/coap_dtn.c, subsys/lichen/coap/coap_keys.c, apps/gateway/src/main.c. Regression from the file-split refactor (4597da630d): the header lives at subsys/lichen/l2/ipv6_addr.h and only the unqualified style (#include "ipv6_addr.h", used by apps/puck and link sources via l2/CMakeLists zephyr_include_directories(.)) resolves. Fix options: (A) one line in lichen/zephyr/CMakeLists.txt: zephyr_include_directories(${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../subsys) - makes the qualified spelling resolve module-wide, or (B) migrate the 5 includes to the unqualified style. NOTE: tests/coap_keys (CONFIG_LICHEN_COAP_SERVER_OSCORE=y build, both native_sim CI and local qemu_x86) cannot compile until this lands; local verification of bd 6mij.2.2 used a throwaway include-dir shim passed as an uncommitted EXTRA_CFLAGS flag. Local validation recipe: west build -b qemu_x86 tests/coap_keys with -DZEPHYR_EXTRA_MODULES=<repo>/lichen, then west build -t run with CONFIG_NET_QEMU_SLIP=n CONFIG_NET_SLIP_TAP=n to suppress the unix-socket serial backend.
